definitions.explanation: The alternating up-and-down kicking of the legs used in the front crawl and backstroke. バタ mimics the flapping sound; {足|あし} means legs or feet.

examples.japanese: バタ{足|あし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧。
⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧バタ{足|あし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I practiced flutter kicks in the pool.

examples.japanese: バタ{足|あし}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧25⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{泳|およ}げる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: I became able to swim 25 meters using only the flutter kick.

notes:
Common beginners' drill, often practiced while holding a kickboard ({ビート板|ビートばん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バタ{足|あし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: flutter-kick practice
- バタ{足|あし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: to have a fast flutter kick
- バタ{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: to swim using the flutter kick

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧: breaststroke — uses a frog kick, not the alternating flutter kick
